headline: HSIE Results Daily: Life Insurance Corporation of India, Titan, Apollo Hospitals Enterprise, Aurobindo Pharma,

highlights: HSIE Research is also available on Bloomberg ERH HDF <GO> & Thomson Reuters 06 November 2026 HSIE Results Daily HSIE Results Daily Contents Results Reviews ■ Life Insurance Corporation of India: Life Insurance Corporation of India (LICI) posted a modest APE growth (+5.7% YoY) to ~INR307bn, while VNB margins clocked in at an impressive 22.3% (+470bps YoY).
While we see an upside risk to our FY27 VNB margin forecasts, we continue to watch out for how H2FY27 pans out, considering the higher base of H2FY26.

We maintain our APE/VNB CAGR of 2%/5% over FY27-FY29E, expect VNB margins to expand to 23% by FY28E, and maintain BUY with a TP of INR555 (0.6x Sep-28 EV). ■ Titan: Consolidated jewelry sales (ex-bullion and digi gold) grew 24.1% YoY to INR175bn (in-line).
Domestic jewelry (ex-bullion, digi gold sales, Caratlane) grew 19.9% YoY (SSSG: 15%), led by studded (+32% YoY) and higher ticket sizes, with buyer growth flat YoY.
valuation: While we see an upside risk to our FY27 VNB margin forecasts, we continue to watch out for how H2FY27 pans out, considering the higher base of H2FY26.
PAT includes a non-operational gain of INR6.71bn from Damas tranche-2 put option liability revaluation.

We have revised EPS estimates by +4.7/+0.2% for FY27/28 respectively and maintain REDUCE with a DCF-based TP of INR4,700/sh (implying ~49x Sep-28 P/E). ■ Apollo Hospitals Enterprise: EBITDA grew 29% YoY, led by 23% YoY sales growth.
watch: While we see an upside risk to our FY27 VNB margin forecasts, we continue to watch out for how H2FY27 pans out, considering the higher base of H2FY26.
India business is expected to outperform IPM growth in FY27E, led by 5-7% volume growth, sustained momentum in key therapies (pain, CVS, anti- diabetics, CNS, and derma), and new launches.
